annotations.text: Left: project tree (All projects → project → worktree). Selecting the root shows the cross-project table with AND-combined filter chips; a project shows its own worktrees; a worktree shows its status and two diff tabs (Working tree · vs main ref). Worktree and Overview are the same prototype opened on different nodes. Tweaks: theme, staleDays, initialView. Refresh replays the two-phase scan; Remove from list / Add project remove and restore a project.
Zero-project state: what the window shows before any repository has been added. Not a loading state.
